response.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_records FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, risk_margin_records, risk_margin_records::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, risk_margin_records::numeric / AVG(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM scope_counts ORDER BY scope

assumptions.assumption: A matched user with a NULL account scope forms a NULL scope group if present.

alternatives.interpretation: Only non-NULL account scopes count as scopes.
alternatives.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_records FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE u.acctscope IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, risk_margin_records, risk_margin_records::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, risk_margin_records::numeric / AVG(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM scope_counts ORDER BY scope
